alderleaf-robotics.example.headline: Alderleaf Robotics closes $42M Series C led by Meridian Ventures
alderleaf-robotics.example.summary: Funding earmarked for expanding fleet-orchestration software team and doubling manufacturing floor deployments in 2026.

alderleaf-robotics.example.headline: Alderleaf promotes Jordan Ellery to VP of Operations
alderleaf-robotics.example.summary: Ellery previously led plant operations at a competitor; brought in to scale multi-site shift coordination.

alderleaf-robotics.example.headline: Alderleaf opens second manufacturing floor in Ohio
alderleaf-robotics.example.summary: New facility adds ~120 employees; company cited operational reporting complexity as a growing pain point in the announcement.
